about: ADR-0052's rules as Excel showed them (verification/2026-09-27-windows-excel-2/active-cell.md): the Focus is Excel's active cell and stays while a range is extended; the Extent is the end that moves. From dotnet/tests/ExGrid.Tests/ActiveCellTests.cs; its key cases move with the keys.

cases.name: ADR-0052 case 1: Shift+Down twice and Shift+Right from B2 give B2:C4, with B2 still the Focus
ADR-0052 case 5: with D5 selected, Ctrl+drag A1:B2 adds a range holding the Focus at A1, and Shift+Down grows it to A1:B3
ADR-0052 case 5 (the ADR's reading): after Enter cycles the Focus into an earlier range, that range extends
ADR-0052 case 7: Shift+Backspace collapses the selection to the Focus: B2 from B2:D4
ADR-0052 case 7: Shift+Backspace collapses the selection to the Focus: D4 from D4:B2
ADR-0052 case 7: Shift+Backspace after Enter collapses to where Enter put the Focus
ADR-0052 case 8: Ctrl+. walks A1:C3's corners clockwise from A1 (C1, C3, A3, A1, C1) and the selection stays
ADR-0052 case 8: with A1:C3,E5:F6 and E5 active, Ctrl+. walks only E5:F6's corners
ADR-0052: Ctrl+. on a range one row deep passes over the corner it shares
ADR-0052: Ctrl+. on one cell does nothing
ADR-0052 (not observed in Excel): from a cell on an edge, Ctrl+. goes to the corner ending that edge clockwise; from inside, to the top-left
ADR-0052 case 11: from B2, Ctrl+Shift+End then Ctrl+Shift+Home keep B2 the Focus
ADR-0052 case 11: from B2, Shift+PageDown moves only the Extent
